Context: 6. Government servants and politics

10. a candidate at election.
11. Displaying on his person, vehicle or residence of any electoral symbol in connection with an election.
12. A Government servant should endeavour to prevent any member of his family from taking part in, subscribing in aid of, or assisting in any other manner any movement or activity which is (or tends to be directly or indirectly) subversive of the Government. If he is unable to do so, he should
11. make a report to that effect to the Government.
